title: Crunchy Italian Fritters
description: Delicious crunchy Italian fritters made with hazelnut and a hint of spices.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (180°C).
In a bowl, mix together the cubed Italian bread, shredded yellow cheese, chopped hazelnuts and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Beat the eggs in a separate bowl and add them to the bread mixture. Mix well.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small balls and coat them with crunchy topping (bread crumbs).
Once the oil is hot, carefully place the fritters in the oil and fry until golden brown (about 3-4 minutes per side).
Drain the fritters on paper towels and serve hot.
Optional: Serve with your favorite dipping sauce.
